_notes.Housing: Each unit takes Army Camp housing by class (Light 2, Medium 5, Heavy 8, TD 5, SPG 6, AA 4, Fighter 5, Ground Attack 6, Bomber 8, Jet Fighter 8, Jet Attack 9, Helicopter 8).
_notes.Oil per Deploy: Oil spent each raid per deployed unit = round(Gold cost x class factor, nearest 5). Factors: Light .65, Medium .60, Heavy .58, TD .62, SPG .60, AA .50, Fighter .60, Ground Attack .70, Bomber .70, Jet Fighter .75, Jet Attack .75, Helicopter .70.
_notes.Air HP: Air units now have HP = DPS x class factor (Fighter 6, Ground Attack 8, Bomber 8, Jet Fighter 6, Jet Attack 8). In v3 these were 0.
_notes.Tier labels: Tiers are POWER tiers, not strict history. A few WW2 units sit in Tier IV (Tiger II, Jagdtiger, Me 262) because they are the best of their nation's WW2 line. Era column shows the real era.
